payload.reason: The evidence provides multiple claims regarding the effectiveness of the NCEL approach, demonstrating its superior performance across various datasets and its efficiency in processing large-scale data.

claims.text: NCEL consistently outperforms various baselines with favorable generalization ability across five public benchmarks.
In both easy and hard datasets, NCEL outperforms all baseline methods, indicating its robustness in different scenarios.
NCEL achieves the best performance in most cases on the GERBIL benchmark, demonstrating good generalization ability across datasets.
